meta.title: Contact Metal Form — send a part, a drawing or a photograph
meta.description: Send a photograph, a sample, a drawing or a CAD file. Initial technical response within 48 business hours: feasibility direction, what is missing and the next step. NDA before detailed disclosure.

headline: Send the part.
Or the photograph
of the part.
hero.lead: There is no form to fill in and no qualification questionnaire. Send what you have, tell us what the part has to do, and we come back with a technical read.

send.heading: What is worth sending
send.body: Any one of these is enough to start a conversation. All of them together is better, but nobody ever has all of them.
items: A photograph of the part, ideally with a ruler or caliper beside it
The physical sample itself, if you can post it
A 2D drawing, even an old one, even a scan
A 3D model — STEP, IGES, X_T, STL, or a native CATIA or SolidWorks file
A rough sketch and a description of what the part has to do
Roughly how many you need per year, even if it is a guess
The material, if you know it — and if you do not, what the part has to survive
The problem you are actually trying to solve: cost, supply, quality, or a part that does not exist yet

steps.title: You send it
steps.body: WhatsApp is fastest, because photographs, drawings and short videos of a part all go through it without an email attachment limit.

steps.title: We read it
steps.body: An engineer looks at the geometry, not a salesperson at a price list. Within 48 business hours you get a feasibility direction, a list of what is missing, and the next step.

steps.title: NDA, if you want one
steps.body: Sign ours or send yours. It is normal, it is quick, and it happens before detailed technical disclosure rather than after.

steps.title: Then a real quotation
steps.body: Once the geometry, the volume and the tolerances are understood. Not before — a number quoted before those are known is a number that changes.

cta.headline: Send it now.
cta.body: A photograph taken on a phone, right now, is more useful to us than a perfectly specified enquiry in three weeks.
